candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old and has had fever for 2 days, with a measured temperature of 38.0°C. There are no signs of convulsing now or history of convulsions, and no lethargy or unconsciousness. The child is able to drink and breastfeed and does not vomit everything. Malaria risk is high in this area, the malaria test was available and the result was positive. There is no generalized rash, no cough or difficult breathing, no runny nose, no red eyes, no stiff neck, and no cough related to measles. There is no history of measles within the last 3 months. There is no obvious cause of fever and no identified bacterial cause. The child does not have diarrhoea or ear problems.
